title: GeometryAuthority
description:
The authority side of the two-sided geometry proof: a snapshot binding a Figma node's DECIDED values (fetched via REST, out of band, saved as a capture file) to the artefact reading in force when the comparison ran.

A ledger under VDS S-4(2). The proof never re-derives the agreement - that would need the values - it verifies the BINDING: both input hashes must still match what is on disk, or the snapshot is STALE, visibly, and proves nothing (draft S-7A(5)).

capture.description: The saved REST capture the authority side was read from, repository-relative. It holds realisations, so it lives in the project tree and NEVER under `.vds/` (VDS S-2(2)).

captureDigest.description: Digest of the capture file at comparison time: the AUTHORITY side's input hash. The capture moving on disk stales this snapshot.

comparator.description:
The out-of-band program that produced the agreement rows, repository-relative. REQUIRED by [2026] VJS-CA-VDS 1 order 6.

The engine cannot re-derive an agreement bit - re-deriving needs the values, which VDS S-2(2) and [2026] VJS-CC-OPBOX 3 forbid it to hold - so the one input that decides the verdict was the one input carrying no witness at all. A comparator rewritten to return agreement unconditionally produced an identical `generatedBy` NAME, regenerated cleanly through the front door, and turned the whole limb green with nothing measured.

comparatorDigest.description: That file's digest at the moment the comparison ran, entering `contentDigest`. A comparator that moved after the comparison is a third expired input (geometry R14).

contentDigest.description: A digest over every other field, for the reason the reading carries one: this snapshot is the proof's only record of the comparison.

fetchedAt.description: When the authority values were FETCHED from the design file's API. The fetch date is part of the claim: an old capture is an old decision.

nodeId.description: The node the authority values were read from, `12:34` spelling.

readingDigest.description: The geometry reading's content digest at comparison time: the ARTEFACT side's input hash. The reading regenerating stales this snapshot.

AgreementState.description:
What the comparator found for one surface kind. THREE-VALUED.

Draft S-7A(5A), ENACTMENT PENDING (SUBMISSION-VDS-019). This was a `bool` and the shape was the defect: [2026] VJS-SC-OPBOX 1 order 6 binds a frame "only for what it draws in the states it draws" and order 14 forbids manufacturing conformance from what was never drawn, and a two-valued field has nowhere to record that the frame drew NOTHING on a dimension. A comparator that finds nothing to compare then has one honest-looking value to write, writes `true`, and the proof records conformance against silence. That is an order defeated by a datatype.

Recorded as Schedule B item 1 of [2026] VJS-CA-VDS 1 (Fidelity J, 012-A, commanding one judge and therefore NOT CARRIED). It is implemented here behind its own pending submission, on this lane's standing posture: the code ships marked as drafted and no warrant may cite it until the ruling lands.

oneOf.description: The shipped reading and the decided values agree on this dimension.
They disagree. `because` is then required: a bare state names no work.
THE SIGNED FRAME DRAWS NOTHING on this dimension. Resolves to no_authority for that surface kind and can never contribute conformance, because a frame binds only for what it draws.

AuthorityAgreement.description:
One surface kind's agreement between the authority and the artefact.

An AGREEMENT STATE and never a value, per the S-2(7) pin amendment: a Figma `cornerRadius` is a realisation and has no field to live in here. The generator that compared the two sides holds the values; this row holds only what it concluded and where to look when the two disagreed.

agrees.description: What the out-of-band comparator found: agrees, disagrees, or the frame drew nothing here.

because.description: Where the disagreement lives, in the comparator's words. Required by the proof when the state is `disagrees`: a bare state names no work.

SurfaceKind.description:
The shapes a bound may be declared over. CLOSED, and closed on purpose.

VDS S-7A(3): the bound is per SURFACE KIND and never one number for the estate. The subscriber project's instrument reported "561 hand-rolled card-geometry containers, pin 561", and that number names no work: it cannot be assigned to anybody, it cannot be finished, and it hides which shapes are worst. An enum rather than a free string is the strongest available form of that rule, because one undifferentiated bucket is then unrepresentable rather than merely discouraged.

oneOf.description: The weight of a surface's boundary: a border, a ring, a divider.
Control density: the spacing step a surface sets its own padding and gaps from.
Type scale: the size and leading step a surface sets its text from.

Timestamp.description: UTC, second resolution, trailing Z. The one canonical form VDS writes.
